title: Pan-Seared Cod with Teriyaki Sauce and Stir-Fried Vegetables
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared cod, served with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce and stir-fried vegetables. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Transfer the cod to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the sliced green onions and cook for 1-2 minutes, until tender.
Add the sliced bell peppers and julienned carrots, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and grated ginger.
Pour the teriyaki sauce over the cooked vegetables and stir to combine.
Return the cod fillets to the skillet and spoon some of the teriyaki sauce over the top.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a complete meal.
